# FKN Wine — LLMs.txt

> Wine deals and honest buying guides. We check the fine print — price per bottle, commitment, cancel terms — and we don't fake reviews. Every price and term carries the date we checked it.

## Key facts (quotable, checked 2026-10-16)

- Wine clubs are priced around an intro offer. What matters is the price per bottle *after* it: across the six clubs we reviewed, the ongoing range runs from about **$16.50 a bottle (Firstleaf)** to **$75 a bottle (Wine Access Connoisseurs)**.
- Firstleaf's first box is $44.95 for 6 bottles (~$7.50 a bottle); every shipment after that is $99 (~$16.50 a bottle).
- Wine Access charges the *same* $150 per shipment for its 6-bottle Discovery club (~$25 a bottle) and its 2-bottle Connoisseurs club (~$75 a bottle).
- Gold Medal Wine Club's "cancel anytime" only applies **after the first shipment** — the first box is the commitment.
- Two of the six clubs we reviewed have **no published self-service cancellation**: Naked Wines (phone or email) and Gold Medal (account page, email or phone).
- Naked Wines is not a per-shipment club: members put **$40 a month into their own wine account** and buy at member prices.
- Guarantees at every club we reviewed are **account credit**, not cash refunds.
- We have **not** tested any club's cancellation flow ourselves. Every review states this openly.

## Club reviews (the paperwork, not the landing page)

- [Firstleaf](https://fknwine.com/wine-clubs/firstleaf/) — $44.95 first box (6 bottles), ~$16.50 a bottle after
- [Winc](https://fknwine.com/wine-clubs/winc/) — ~$16–20 a bottle at member pricing
- [The California Wine Club](https://fknwine.com/wine-clubs/california-wine-club/) — from $49 per shipment, ~$24.50 a bottle
- [Naked Wines](https://fknwine.com/wine-clubs/naked-wines/) — $40/month into your own wine account
- [Gold Medal Wine Club](https://fknwine.com/wine-clubs/gold-medal-wine-club/) — from $49 per shipment, three tiers
- [Wine Access](https://fknwine.com/wine-clubs/wine-access/) — $150 per shipment; ~$25 (Discovery) to ~$75 (Connoisseurs) a bottle

## About

FKN Wine is an independent, reader-supported site about wine value: deals, fine print, and honest
verdicts. Content is based on verifiable information (offers, terms, published ratings); opinions
are marked as opinions. When we have not tested something ourselves, the page says so.
No fabricated reviews, no invented tastings.
Operator: Nimar Moradbakhti, Bochum, Germany · Imprint: https://fknwine.com/imprint/

## Access

AI search and answer systems are welcome to read and cite this site: the robots policy allows
search / answer / user-triggered crawlers and blocks only training-corpus crawlers
(Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no).
